meta.title: Replace node-sass with sass (Dart Sass) for improved compatibility and build stability
meta.body_summary: Migrate from deprecated node-sass to Dart Sass to fix build failures and improve compatibility.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot swapped node-sass for dart-sass; maintainer nsano-rururu closed it due to element-ui incompatibility with sass.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1407 changed lines, mostly in lockfile, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. It fits a dependency migration performance PR but was closed due to library incompatibility, not change size.

review_details.concern_detail: element-ui does not support Dart Sass; maintainer suggested using the vue3 migration PR instead.
review_details.performance_claim: Dart Sass is faster than node-sass and improves build stability.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer requested to close PR citing element-ui incompatibility and pointing to a vue3 migration PR.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent replaced a build dependency without checking whether existing UI library (element-ui) supports Dart Sass; closed because the change would break another part of the build stack.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer noted that element-ui does not support sass and that the change should be part of a future vue3 migration.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance evidence; maintainer did not evaluate performance claims because PR was closed for incompatibility.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix attempted.

core_change_summary.description: Replace 'node-sass ^9.0.0' with 'sass ^1.83.0' in package.json and update package-lock.json accordingly.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lockfile churn accounts for 1405 of 1407 lines; actual dependency change is a single line in package.json.
change_trajectory: Replace node-sass with sass in package.json and lockfile.

review_signals.summary: element-ui does not support sass. Please include in vue3 migration PR (#711) and close this PR.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with dependency swap.
~12.5 hours later maintainer responded noting element-ui incompatibility and requested close.
PR closed ~1.7 hours after comment, total lifespan ~14.2 hours.
